name: React Flow
summary: A strong React node/edge editor. The spike rendered and fit the graph, but it requires React and does not provide X6-style general diagram editing, layouts, stencils, snaplines or a non-React integration.
losses: Node/edge editor, not a general diagram editor
No built-in general layouts or stencil

spike.scenario: 20 nodes, 20 edges, React 19, React Flow fitView, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: Bundle excludes the separate 15.87 KB CSS file. React 19 was used; the package supports React 18/19 via peers.

blockers: Node/flow editor only, not a general diagram editor.
